subscribed. What should I do?\n      </h1>\n    </div>\n\n  </div>\n\n  \n    \n      \n      <div class=\"absolute z-20 top-0 left-0 h-full w-full bg-home bg-cover bg-center\"></div>\n    \n  \n\n  \n  <div class=\"absolute z-10 top-0 left-0 h-full w-full bg-hero\"></div>\n\n  </div> \n\n<div class=\"container flex-1 relative z-20 pb-8 border-bottom\" id=\"page-container\">\n  <div class=\"row row-lg shadow -mt-8\">\n\n    <article class=\"col bg-white lg:border-radius-left\" itemscope=\"\" itemtype=\"http://schema.org/Article\">\n      <div class=\"my-7 md:mx-5\">\n\n        \n        <div class=\"flex mb-5\">\n          <div class=\"media\">\n            \n              <div class=\"avatar\">\n                \n                <img class=\"avatar-img w-7 h-7\" alt=\"Support\"     \n                  \n                    Support\n                  \n                  \n                  \n                \n                <ul class=\"list-divider\">\n                  \n                    <li class=\"text-gray-600\">\n                      \n                        Updated\n                        <time datetime=\"2023-07-21T03:47:19Z\" title=\"07/21/2023, 03:47\" </div>\n            \n\n            \n            \n              <div class=\"subscribe-article\">\n                <div data-helper=\"subscribe\" data-json=\"{&quot;item&quot;:&quot;article&quot;,&quot;url&quot;:&quot;/hc/en-us/articles/16175881941393-I-can-t-use-the-Pro-features-even-though-I-m-already-subscribed-What-should-I-do/subscription.json&quot;,&quot;follow_label&quot;:&quot;Follow&quot;,&quot;unfollow_label&quot;:&quot;Unfollow&quot;,&quot;following_label&quot;:&quot;Following&quot;,&quot;can_subscribe&quot;:true,&quot;is_subscribed&quot;:false}\"></div>\n              </div>\n            \n          </div>\n        </div>\n\n        \n        <section class=\"content article-content mb-6\" itemprop=\"articleBody\">\n          <ul class=\"accordion_list\">\n<li>\n<h3 class=\"accordion_title\">Google Play Store</h3>\n<div class=\"accordion_content\"><span style=\"font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif;\">If you’re experiencing issues when using the Pro features in the app even though you have an active subscription, we recommend trying the following to troubleshoot the issue:</span>\n<ol>\n<ol>\n<li><strong>Reboot your device.</strong></li>\n<li><strong>Confirm that you’re signed into the Google Play account with the Alight Motion subscription.</strong>&nbsp;Go to Google Play &gt; tap your profile on the top-right corner of the screen &gt;&nbsp;<em>Payments and Subscriptions</em>&nbsp;&gt;&nbsp;<em>Subscriptions</em>.\n<ul>\n<li>If you’re signed into multiple Google Play accounts, sign out of the other accounts that don't have the Alight Motion subscription. Being signed into multiple accounts can sometimes cause subscriptions not to register correctly.</li>\n<li>If you don't see Alight Motion in the subscriptions list, we recommend&nbsp;<a href=\"https://support.google.com/googleplay/gethelp\">contacting Google Play Support</a>.</li>\n</ul>\n</li>\n<li><strong>Refresh My Account.</strong>&nbsp;Open the app &gt; open&nbsp;<em>My Account</em>&nbsp;from the top right corner of the screen &gt; tap the three vertical dots on the top-right corner &gt; tap&nbsp;<em>Refresh</em>.</li>\n<li><strong><a href=\"https://support.google.com/googleplay/answer/9037938\">Update Google Play &amp; Google Play services</a></strong>&nbsp;on your Settings app.</li>\n</ol>\n</ol>\n<p>&nbsp;</p>\n<p><strong style=\"font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif;\">If you still need help</strong><span style=\"font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif;\">, you’re welcome to&nbsp;</span><em style=\"font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif;\">Submit a request</em><span style=\"font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif;\">&nbsp;from the top of this page. We recommend including the following information:</span></p>\n<ul>\n<li>The order number of the subscription purchase. This can be found in your email receipts/invoices from Google Play.</li>\n<li>The email address of the Google Play account used to subscribe to Alight Motion.</li>\n<li>A screenshot of the <em>My Account</em> screen from Alight Motion: open the app &gt; open&nbsp;<em>My Account</em>&nbsp;from the top right corner of the screen &gt; take a screenshot.</li>\n</ul>\n<p>&nbsp;</p>\n</div>\n</li>\n<li>\n<h3 class=\"accordion_title\">Apple App Store</h3>\n<div class=\"accordion_content\">\n<p>If you’re experiencing issues when using the Pro features in the app even though you have an active subscription, we recommend following these steps to troubleshoot the issue:</p>\n<ol>\n<li>Reboot your device</li>\n<li>On the <em>Settings</em> app, make sure that you’re signed in with the Apple ID used to subscribe to Alight Motion</li>\n<li>Open Alight Motion &gt; open&nbsp;<em>My Account</em>&nbsp;from the top right corner of the screen</li>\n<li>Tap the three vertical dots on the top-right corner &gt; tap&nbsp;<em>Refresh</em></li>\n</ol>\n<p>At this point, you should be able to see the subscription details and enjoy its benefits.</p>\n<p>&nbsp;</p>\n<p><strong>If you still need help</strong>, you’re welcome to&nbsp;<em>Submit a request</em>&nbsp;from the top of this page. We recommend including the following information:</p>\n<ul>\n<li>A screenshot showing your subscription information: go to the Settings app on the device &gt; tap your name &gt; <em>Subscriptions</em>&nbsp;&gt;&nbsp;<em>Alight Motion</em>&nbsp;&gt; take a screenshot.</li>\n<li>A screenshot of the <em>My Account</em> screen from Alight Motion: open the app &gt; open <em>My Account</em>&nbsp;from the top right corner of the screen &gt; take a screenshot.</li>\n<li>A screenshot or a screen recording that could show your experience.</li>\n</ul>\n</div>\n</li>\n</ul>\n\n
